newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA to buy 108,000T US soybean at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA to buy 108,000T US soybean at tender.

text.p: The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association plans to tender on Thursday for two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybean, traders said on Wednesday.
Last Friday, the Breakfast Association's Kaohsiung division bought two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybeans.
A buyer said the Taichung division would use prices from that earlier purchase as a benchmark in Thursday's tender.
Buyers said both divisions moved up the schedule of their tenders to stay ahead of rising freight prices.
"It's better to buy while freight prices are still low," a buyer in the Kaohsiung division said on condition his name not be given.
